# `Scanner/EPISetup-v0` · Set up a single-shot EPI that meets its limits in the least scan time

**D · Image quality and artefacts** · artefacts · kind 3, trade · isolates D11: Distortion by off-resonance: displacement, stretching, pile-up. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** CANDIDATE: the gate has not been run (no stored result)

Echo-planar imaging trades everything against everything: a long echo spacing has little noise and little ghost and a large displacement; a short phase field of view shortens the train and wraps; the phase-encode axis decides which regions ghost and where fat lands. The field, the gradient delay, the shape of the object and the noise are hidden, so the protocol has to be measured for. At the development gate (60 instances per level; its result is not stored) a fixed list of scans passed within three instances of the reference at each level, which makes this a measurement task: a signal-free scan for the noise, a two-echo gradient echo for the field and the shape of the object (at level 3 one more for the oil), an echo-planar scan at the highest bandwidth on each phase-encode axis for the gradient delay, and one echo-planar scan of a fixed protocol at each end of the echo-time window, then the reference's solver. Measurement task or decision task (does a fixed list of scans pass within 25 points of the reference?): not determined, the gate result is not stored yet.

Kind of task: **{'kind': 'undetermined', 'levels': {}, 'evidence': 'no stored gate result'}**.

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'pe_dir': 'y | x', 'pe_polarity': '1 | -1', 'bandwidth_hz_per_px': '<hertz per pixel>', 'matrix': '<even integer>', 'phase_fov': '<fraction>', 'centre_pe_mm': '<millimetres>', 'te_ms': '<milliseconds>', 'averages': '<integer>'}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; the console accepts the delivered scan
- Error: `averages of the delivered scan minus the fewest with which any allowed protocol meets the requirements`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates; echo time in the window; pixel within the ceiling; displacement <= 3 mm and ghost <= 5 % for each region; wrap-around energy <= 0.2 %; fat <= 5 % per region; SNR >= the floor in each region; averages <= the fewest that suffice

## Gate: the control policies on fresh instances

**Gate not stored on this engine** (`mrgym-engine-0.3.0`). `mrgym gate Scanner/EPISetup-v0 --n 300 --write` measures and stores it.

| Policy | Must | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `reference` | pass | field map, object extent, noise and gradient delay from four scans of its own; per phase-encode axis the shortest phase field of view and the lowest bandwidth within the displacement limit; the best candidate is run once for its averages |
| `prior` | fail | no scan; the console's default EPI |
| `default_epi` | fail | one token scan, then the console's default EPI |
| `fastest_epi` | fail | one token scan, then the EPI with the shortest echo train (highest bandwidth, one average) |
| `fixed_recipe` | fail | one token scan, then the best constant protocol tuned on other worlds |
| `wrong_units` | fail | the reference with the off-resonance in rad/s read as Hz |
| `sweep` | fail | EPIs at five bandwidths, the lowest whose measured ghost is within the limit; no field map, no model |
| `ignore_field` | ablation | the reference without the field map: the lowest bandwidth the echo-time window allows |
| `ignore_ghost` | ablation | the reference without the delay measurement: the largest predicted SNR whatever the ghost |
| `square_fov` | ablation | the reference with the full phase field of view on the isocentre |
| `ignore_fat` | ablation | the reference without looking for the oil (level 3) |
| `open_loop` | reported | a fixed list of scans; the SNR of the chosen protocol is scaled from two EPIs of a fixed protocol with the SNR laws |

## What the agent reads at reset (level 2, seed 0)

~~~text
# Set up a single-shot EPI that meets its limits in the least scan time
A test object with vials of unknown materials lies in the field of
view. The examination needs a single-shot gradient-echo EPI of the regions R1 and R2:
    sequence epi, fov_mm 240, slice_mm 5, tr_ms 2000, flip_deg 90, full k-space, no fat saturation,
    echo spacing at the console minimum of the bandwidth.
You choose pe_dir, pe_polarity, bandwidth_hz_per_px, matrix, phase_fov, centre_pe_mm, te_ms and averages. centre_pe_mm is the
centre of the field of view along the phase-encode axis, in mm from the isocentre; along the readout it stays on the isocentre.
Convention of this console: with pe_polarity 1 a spin above resonance is displaced towards the negative end of the
phase-encode axis (-y for pe_dir y, -x for pe_dir x), a spin below resonance (fat) towards the positive end; pe_polarity -1 reverses both.
Regions (circles; centre and radius in mm from the isocentre; each lies inside one homogeneous material):
  R1: y -6.29, x 24.69, radius 6
  R2: y 9.53, x -47.17, radius 6
Requirements:
  - echo time: te_ms between 35 and 50 ms
  - pixel: fov_mm / matrix at most 3.4 mm
  - displacement: the off-resonance field shifts the material of each region by at most 3 mm along the phase-encode axis
  - ghost: the Nyquist ghost of each region (its copy half a phase field of view away) is at most 5 % of the region's signal
  - wrap: the object does not wrap around in the phase-encode direction
  - SNR: at least 17.9 in each region; SNR = mean of the magnitude image over the pixels of a region / standard deviation of the noise in one pixel, one channel (real or imaginary part)
  - scan time: not longer than the shortest scan time with which any protocol meets the requirements above
Deliver the protocol with `submit`. The scan is not run in this episode: the scanner evaluates the protocol you
deliver. Your own scans may use any sequence and any parameters the console accepts; only the deliverable is evaluated, on the scan the task names. That scan is not charged to the scan-time budget and not limited by it.
Nothing about the object, the field, the noise or the state of the system is known in advance.

Passing: every requirement holds, evaluated on noise-free scans of your protocol on the hidden object: displacement,
ghost and wrap against the same scan with that one mechanism switched off, the SNR with the noise level of this
scanner. The scanner's log must show that you measured. An answer in the wrong unit is wrong.

Limits. Scan time: 85 s (only `scan` spends it). Tool calls: 72 (every call counts once unless rejected). Rejected calls: 8 (a call refused for how it is written: unknown name, wrong type; costs nothing else), of them at most 3 refused `submit` calls. The episode ends at `submit` or at a limit; without `submit` the score is 0.
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier's scans are noise-free and its noise is analytic.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
